definition.en: The attachment of a muscle that usually stays still, often the end nearer the trunk. Which end actually moves depends on the movement.
definition.zh: 肌肉通常不动的那一端附着，多半靠近躯干。实际哪一端在动，要看具体动作。

definition.en: The attachment of a muscle that is usually pulled towards the other end when the muscle shortens.
definition.zh: 肌肉收缩时通常被拉向另一端的那一端附着。

definition.en: A strong cord of connective tissue that carries a muscle's pull to a bone.
definition.zh: 把肌肉的拉力传到骨上的一束坚韧结缔组织。

definition.en: The thick, fleshy part of a muscle, made of the fibres that contract.
definition.zh: 肌肉中间粗而有肉的部分，由能收缩的肌纤维组成。

definition.en: The small hook on the front of the shoulder blade where the short head of biceps and coracobrachialis begin.
definition.zh: 肩胛骨前面的小钩状突起，肱二头肌短头和喙肱肌从这里起始。

definition.en: The top end of the ulna that forms the point of the elbow; the triceps tendon attaches here.
definition.zh: 尺骨上端形成肘尖的部分，肱三头肌腱附着在这里。

definition.en: Bending a joint so the angle between the two bones gets smaller, such as bringing the forearm towards the upper arm.
definition.zh: 弯曲关节，使两骨之间的夹角变小，例如把前臂拉向上臂。

definition.en: Straightening a joint so the angle between the two bones gets larger.
definition.zh: 伸直关节，使两骨之间的夹角变大。

definition.en: Turning the forearm so the palm faces up when the elbow is bent, or forward when the arm hangs. The radius rolls back beside the ulna.
definition.zh: 转动前臂，屈肘时使掌心朝上，手臂下垂时使掌心朝前；桡骨转回到与尺骨并排。

definition.en: Turning the forearm so the palm faces down when the elbow is bent. The radius crosses over the front of the ulna.
definition.zh: 转动前臂，屈肘时使掌心朝下；桡骨交叉到尺骨前方。

definition.en: Tilting the hand at the wrist towards the thumb side; also called wrist abduction.
definition.zh: 手在腕部向拇指一侧偏，也叫腕外展。

definition.en: Electromyography: recording the electrical activity of a muscle. A higher reading does not show that the muscle is producing more force or will grow more.
definition.zh: 肌电图：记录肌肉的电活动。读数更高，并不说明肌肉出力更大，也不说明它会长得更多。

definition.en: The part of a movement in which a muscle keeps working while it lengthens, such as slowly lowering the weight in a curl.
definition.zh: 动作中肌肉一边用力一边被拉长的阶段，例如弯举时慢慢放下重量。
